speechPolicy: No recording of an anime or game performance. The original fighters' voices are the game's own (voice/originals/manifest.json).
musicPolicy: Original compositions only (/assets/music/manifest.json); no licensed song or recording.
originals: Signature cues: sound design made for the game; each entry lists its sources. The fighters' own lines play under these cue names, so these are what the names hold if a line drops out.
